retention_tricks: Rapid Cuts: Fast-paced editing with frequent scene changes to maintain visual stimulation.
Sound Design: Strategic use of engaging sound effects, upbeat background music, and sudden audio changes.
On-Screen Text: Dynamic text overlays that highlight key points or add humor, breaking visual monotony.
Story Arc/Tease: Hinting at a big reveal or solution towards the end, creating anticipation.
Energy & Pacing: High-energy delivery, consistent quick pacing, and no dead air or slow moments.
Visual Gags/Surprises: Unexpected visual elements, quick jokes, or surprising outcomes to delight viewers.
